changes.comment: Files written into an open vault from outside the app (an agent, a script, another editor) appear as they land instead of at the next launch. When many land at once the app holds them for review: one dialog covers everything held, Apply works inside shared folders too, and dismissing it is logged.

A shared folder stuck on "refused" recovers on its own: a refusal the relay can take back is retried on a fresh connection, with backoff, and the drawer says the app is retrying rather than asking you to link the device again. A refusal names its reason, and only a dead link is blamed on the link.
Linking a device carries every shared folder, including the ones joined or carved while the vault was private.

A note that is open while its folder is shared keeps syncing what you type after the share; undo keeps working in every note after Stop sharing; a note is read-only for the moment its folder is being shared or unshared.
The notification drawer can be cleared, all at once (Clear all) or one row at a time.
Error and warning toasts sit on an opaque surface, and the floating bars and the dock follow the on-screen keyboard and the visual viewport in Firefox and on phones.
Settings › Editor has options for spelling, autocorrect and sentence capitals.
The app runs under its strict Content Security Policy in Firefox again: nothing evaluates code.
